## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated; `python -m unittest discover tests` passes
- [ ] Branch from `dev`, pull request into `dev`; the title says what changes for users (it becomes the line in the release notes)
- [ ] If measured or evaluated numbers change (units, aggregation, formulas, rounding, timers) or metrics are renamed: label `changes-numbers`, and the affected metrics are named above
- [ ] Type of change for the next release (see [Versions and releases](https://github.com/Beuth-Erdelt/DBMS-Benchmarker/blob/master/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md#versions-and-releases)):
  - [ ] patch (evaluation, dashboard, reports, docs, fixes)
  - [ ] minor (what an experiment executes or records, config or result folder format)
- [ ] Material from others is listed in `THIRD_PARTY.md`
- [ ] I agree that my contribution is licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later
